name: std::is_eq, std::is_neq, std::is_lt, std::is_gt, std::is_lteq, std::is_gteq
intro:
These functions take a result of 3-way comparison and convert it to the result of one of the six relational operators

Specifically, these functions return

1) cmp == 0

2) cmp != 0

3) cmp < 0

4) cmp <= 0

5) cmp > 0

6) cmp >= 0

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: bool result of the corresponding relational operation
